messages:
maya: Quick postmortem follow-up 76 pattern: tiny flag -> slow drift -> human rollback too late. Need faster detection + small auto-rollback for canaries.

trent: +1. Proposal: default canary 1%, max blast 2%. Auto-rollback if two signals (error_rate & p95) exceed thresholds for 3 consecutive 1m windows.

noor: I'll own the telemetry changes (1m EMAs, near-miss rollup). ETA 2026-04-04. Will add dashboard panel for 'near misses'.

felix: I'll build a minimal controller with multi-signal rules and a rapid-sample mode to reduce noise. Target prototype + RFC by 2026-03-31.

maya: Runbook updates: add canary checklist and tabletop drill. sam to schedule drill for 2026-04-09, add rollback contacts.

ops-bot: Ops reminder: canary drill scheduled 2026-04-09 14:00 UTC.

trent: Action items:
- felix: controller + RFC (INF-5100) due 2026-03-31.
- noor: telemetry + dashboards (INF-5101) due 2026-04-04.
- sam: runbook & drill (OPS-5100) schedule by 2026-04-05.

maya: Goal: shrink detection->rollback median to under 15m for regressions. Keep implementation small and reversible. Ping #eng-oncall for blockers. :thumbsup:
